verdict.rationale: RudderStack is explicitly warehouse-native: it ships warehouse/lake destinations (Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, S3) with auto-schema handling, supports scheduled reverse ETL sync from warehouses, and Profiles/identity resolution builds customer 360 directly in the customer's own warehouse via declarative YAML. Open-source self-hosted option gives full control over data plane/schedule. Missing for 10: no explicit named list of supported warehouse destinations with sync-schedule configuration details, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of scheduling controls beyond docs.
